findings.title: [P2] Return None when no user matches
findings.body: When `users` is empty or no user has the requested name, `matches[0]` raises `IndexError` instead of returning `None`. This breaks both the previous behavior and the documented contract. Guard the empty result before indexing.

review_output.overall_explanation: The change introduces a confirmed regression: unsuccessful user lookups now raise IndexError rather than returning None.

content.text:
